elements.element: Transition assistance provided by Vendor on expiry or termination
elements.evidence: Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, HDI shall (a) ... provide reasonable transition assistance
for a period of up to six (6) months
return to the Company all Content, user information, customer data and other Company data in HDI's possession or control
within 30 days after such expiration or termination, return to the Company all Content...
(c) thereafter delete such Content, information and data from its systems
and certify such deletion to the Company in writing
for a period of up to six (6) months (exceeds 90 days)
within 30 days after such expiration or termination, return ... in a standard machine-readable format

reasons: The inserted Section 4.3 completes every atomic element of the preferred position: 6-month assistance at then-current rates, 30-day return of Company data in a standard machine-readable format, and deletion with written certification thereafter.

The deterministic flag that the 30-day return period is not express appears to be a wording artifact; the operative text states 'within 30 days after such expiration or termination, return to the Company all Content, user information, customer data and other Company data'.

The 'at the Company's request' condition attaches only to limb (a) transition assistance; the return, deletion and certification obligations in (b) and (c) remain unconditional, so the mandatory data-return mechanic is not swallowed by a request condition.

Minimality is satisfied: the Agreement had no exit mechanic at all, and the addition is a single concise clause with no rewrite of the surrounding term, termination-notice or Termination Payment provisions.

Intent preserved: the insertion uses existing defined terms (HDI, Company) and introduces no contradiction or dangling mechanic; 'reasonable' as a qualifier on assistance is a minor drafting nuance to note, not a material shortfall.
